dashboard.description: Show live sessions, file claims, and collisions in the current repo.

context.description: Show the shared-context ledger, task board, and recent events.

ledger.description: Write or inspect shared notes, decisions, questions, and tasks.

claim.description: Claim work on the shared task board and show the resulting queue.

fleet.description: Show other repos on this machine that currently have live CoordKit sessions.

message.description: Deliver a message to another live instance in the same repo.

guard.description: Report or change the current anti-clobber enforcement mode.

statusline-setup.description: Install or verify the command-center statusline badge.

dev-docs.description: Refresh project documentation before a context reset.

dev-docs-update.description: Update active development notes and unfinished work before compaction.

route-research-for-testing.description: Route route-contract research into a read-only verification workflow.

linear.description: Bridge Linear issues and the shared ledger: pull issues as tasks, push claims/notes/blocks/done into one persistent Linear comment per issue.
